hook: 押韻 -ire：umpire 哨子、mire／quagmire 泥沼、spire 尖塔、attire 禮服——一場濕答答的禮儀賽。
script: umpire 吹哨。mire／quagmire 踩泥。spire 尖塔；enquire／attire／entire／expire——哨塔長：leave the quagmire of peeking；expire bad endpoints。

members.speakLineEn: Cue the 哨子: umpire walks on and the gag sticks.
members.speakLineZh: 請「哨子」出場：umpire 一上場梗就黏住——裁判。
